title: Enterprise Connectivity: lifecycle charges
content:
## Application
Enterprise Connectivity governs lifecycle charges for service charge.

## Policy clause 1
This fee branch applies only to setup, resumption, termination and bank-return fee source classification.

## Policy clause 2
Charge activation fee once for an activated holding, restoration fee per distinct completed restoration, on-demand termination fee for on-demand exit, and bank-return fee per completed bank return.

## Policy clause 3
An unexpired commitment exit instead bills the recorded recorded remaining commitment liability in USD as its termination liability.

## Policy clause 4
Copy the exact source transition, customer authorization or bank notice reference; do not use a primary meter as fee evidence.

## Policy clause 5
A zero fee is waived without a financial event.

## Policy clause 6
The fee amount is the selected policy amount or recorded signed liability, rounded using monetary decimal places and rounding convention, then taxed under tax treatment rules.

## Policy clause 7
The primary-usage branch of primary usage pricing and its posted meter gate apply only to source classification primary; supplemental charges use the category meter policy.

## Policy clause 8
Already billed source occurrence and fee subtype make repetition read-only.

## Points of judgement
Already billed source occurrence and fee subtype make repetition read-only.

## Tier references
The contract tier supplies the activation fee, restoration fee, on-demand termination fee, bank-return fee, monetary decimal places, rounding convention used by this rule.
